desc: GitHub #42: the battle's Change Partner list shows each partner's own HP. Seven partners at different HP set in the field (Yoshi KO'd, Flurrie's max raised), Goombella out and hurt again in the battle; Mario's Tactics, Change Partner: every row draws its partner's HP and max (the one out: its unit's; the others: the pouch's), never other bytes of the row (0.4.1 read the rows at the GameCube's 32-bit stride). Then Koops swapped in, and the list again: Goombella's HP as the swap wrote it back. At 4:3. Shots: the ring, the list, the next turn, the list after the swap, its end
log_must: ^\[practice\] partner 1 hp set to 4 \(its battle unit too\)$
